A '''company lieutenant''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|second-in-command]] of a [[Company/Legends|company]], serving under the company [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. The [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] was graded as SC1. Company lieutenants could serve in [[assault company]], a [[line company]], a [[drop company]], an [[artillery battery]], an [[attack armor company]], a [[breakthrough armor company]], a [[repulsorlift company]], a [[special missions company]], a [[scout troop]], and a [[COMPNOR observer company]].<ref name="Sourcebook" />
